notes:
Account summary
- Regulated healthcare provider (US). Strong compliance posture. They are exploring LLM inference for internal workflows (summarization + support agent + “clinical notes assist”), but will not send PHI to a public endpoint.
- Primary ask: Private/VPC deployment path with enterprise controls + clear audit logging/retention story.

Key contacts (from calls / emails)
- Security reviewer: “GRC lead + security architect” (names not captured in notes; asked for written controls + artifacts).
- Platform lead: wants a consistent runtime across teams; cares about routing/fallback and operational burden.
- Procurement: not engaged yet; security sign-off required before commercial paper.

Requirements / constraints (high confidence)
- Deployment: VPC-only for any real data; willing to use hosted API only with synthetic data for early evaluation.
- Data residency: US-only processing and logging. They explicitly asked: “No cross-region failover by default.”
- Audit logs: must capture auth events, key creation/rotation, role changes, policy changes, and inference request metadata (at least: model/route, timestamp, project, status). Need export to SIEM (they mentioned Splunk) and guidance on event schema.
- Retention controls: customer-configurable retention for logs/telemetry; clear boundaries on whether prompts/outputs are stored. They asked for deletion behavior and proof (“deletion confirmation”).
- IAM: SSO/SAML (Okta) + RBAC. Must be able to enforce SSO and map Okta groups to roles; least-privilege access. Requested examples of role definitions.
- Encryption/KMS: expects encryption at rest + option for customer-managed keys (KMS). Asked about key rotation cadence and auditability.

What resonated
- “Unified inference across hosted/dedicated/private” story landed with platform team; they want to avoid rebuilding ops for each environment.
- Reliability/fallback: they like the concept but only if it can be constrained to approved regions and model families.
- Observability: audit logs + usage/cost breakdowns are important, but they will not accept any UI that implies storing PHI prompts/outputs.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Confirm if they require on-prem / air-gapped (currently: no, but ‘future possibility’).
- Determine whether they need HIPAA BAA/DPA; they asked generally about DPAs and incident notifications.
- Clarify whether they require log export streaming vs periodic batch export.

Artifacts shared / referenced
- Shared security FAQ link set (internal: demo-security-faq-links-and-answers). Promised to provide SOC 2 letter via approved process.
- Pointed to “Private/VPC architecture” slides/screenshots for narrative only (no production tenant access for security reviewers).

POC outline (proposed)
- 4-week POC in HelioHealth non-prod VPC using synthetic data only.
- Success criteria: p95 latency targets by route, throughput under load, audit log completeness, retention policy controls, and SSO/RBAC enforcement.

Risk / deal notes
- This deal is security-gated. If we can’t provide crisp answers on retention and audit log export, they will default to cloud-native options (Bedrock/Azure) despite lower performance.
- Need tight coordination with Security/Compliance and SE for a consistent story: what is logged, what is not, and what’s configurable.
